scientific_role: opened-outcome candidate-frame diagnosis; cannot support confirmation or promotion
reason_for_test: the previously frozen 2/5-km LOCAL portable-coastal frames reached only 1 of 15 later novel populations even at 100% candidate coverage, so the next question is frame reachability before selector refinement

declared_broad_frame.source: pre-existing ACSP Okinawa-main frame; unchanged from the prior portable-coastal smoke

candidate_frame.grid_role: broad screening grid selected before this execution for tractable provider-wide screening; not an exact-site claim and not candidate-count-equivalent to the prior 100-m LOCAL grid
candidate_frame.local_boundary_source: the already-frozen sensitivity outer radius in public_cirsium_portable_coastal_smoke_v1
candidate_frame.detached_rule: candidate is DETACHED_BROAD when it lies on valid WorldCover land inside the declared broad frame and nearest historical population distance is > 5.0 km
candidate_frame.definition_note: DETACHED_BROAD includes both different ecological components and remote parts of the same source-backed component; it is defined by being outside the justified local continuation frame, not by a post-outcome habitat threshold

worldcover.land_definition: valid WorldCover class other than permanent water class 80
worldcover.component_rule: 8-neighbour connected components on WorldCover land raster
worldcover.coast_distance_rule: Euclidean raster distance to class-80 water; no fitted threshold

outcome.novel_population_rule: deterministic complete-link 0.5 km; >0.5 km from every strict historical population
outcome.primary_diagnostic: full broad-frame reachability versus the previously frozen 5-km LOCAL frame
outcome.secondary_diagnostic: within DETACHED_BROAD, full prefix curves for structural versus nearest versus spatial balance

forbidden: do not change the 5-km local boundary after observing detached outcomes
do not change 250-m broad-screen spacing after observing outcomes and rerun as if prospective
do not add a fitted structural threshold or distance-structure blend
do not choose only favorable prefix/radius cells
do not relabel this opened CIR08 diagnostic as confirmation
do not modify the independently validated 2.5% / 10-km product
